item.title: New release: PLAXIS 2026.1: Elevate 3D foundation design with the new embedded beam
item.description: The latest PLAXIS release features a new embedded beam formulation for PLAXIS 3D. It also introduces an enhanced Help menu and several improvements to the calculation input and results database. These enhancements offer improved pile foundation modelling capabilities with reduced project sizes and more consistent results.

item.title: Solved: Windows Update KB issue with opening PLAXIS files resolved in V2025.1.3 and V2024.3.1
item.description: July 17 2026: Issue with non-security Windows Update item KB5083631 (26200.8328) in PLAXIS 2025.1.x and PLAXIS 2024.3.0 is now fully resolved with the release of PLAXIS 2025.1.3 and PLAXIS 2024.3.1.

item.title: Known Issue: Unable to open existing projects in PLAXIS 2D/3D 2024.3
item.description: An issue has been identified where existing PLAXIS projects unexpectedly fail to open in PLAXIS 2D/3D 2024.3 and PLAXIS 2D/3D 2025.1.x. This is likely linked to a Windows Update KB5083631 rolled out. Current workaround includes starting PLAXIS as Administrator. This is now fully resolved with the release of PLAXIS 2025.1.3 and PLAXIS 2024.3.1.

item.title: New release: PLAXIS 2025.1: Unleashing Next-Level Data Performance
item.description: The latest PLAXIS release features a new database for calculation input and results. This upgrade offers faster output with improved data accessibility and more consistent results while enabling users to push modelling boundaries.

item.title: New releases: PLAXIS 2024.3
item.description: Upgrade to PLAXIS 2024.3 for enhanced 3D design approaches and improved project conversion. And with general availability of modal analysis for Monopile Designer. Ensure compliance with Eurocode and other standards and enjoy seamless integration of older projects with the latest features.

item.title: New release: PLAXIS 2024.2
item.description: This latest PLAXIS release includes two new user defined materials models to enhance tailings dams and design of tunnels in swelling rocks

item.title: Advanced technology benefits Melbourne commuters. Cuts project costs by $16m
item.description: Better cross-functional working and a digital strategy helped optimise delivery of this $11bn mega project which will cut travel times reduce pollution and boost efficiency for residents and businesses.

item.title: PLAXIS 30 years: pave the way for a promising future
item.description: 30 years of innovation at PLAXIS drove the geotechnical analysis industry.
